rca of the issue: ResizeObserver loop overlay: Likely Radix Sheet/Select close animations cause ResizeObserver to fire after children unmount; React-DevServer overlay surfaces the (benign) warning as a fatal error and blocks the page. Mitigation: install a top-level window.error suppressor for 'ResizeObserver loop' message, or upgrade the Radix primitives. Backend 403 on X-Admin-Token: brief said X-Admin-Token; server rejects it for the audit/team endpoints — needs alignment with the actual auth contract enforced by /api/admin/* routes.
